free_tier.stated: no free GPU tier is published; the rate card read on 2026-11-03 shows A100 80GB at USD 0.89 an hour on the Dynamic plan and USD 1.43 on the Dedicated plan, L40S 48GB at USD 0.92 on the Dedicated plan, RTX 6000 Pro at USD 0.66 and B200 at USD 3.75 Dynamic and USD 6.99 Dedicated. The RTX 4090 row shows no on-demand price on the rate card; the comparison table lists 'RTX 4090' at USD 0.39 as the packet.ai starting rate. H100 SXM and H200 are labelled 'Coming soon'. No L4 is listed.
free_tier.notes: Dynamic is a shared card with scheduler-enforced isolation; Dedicated is a whole card; hourly pods are billed in 30-minute periods from a prepaid wallet

per_object_cap.notes: pods are one or more cards

retention.notes: a stopped pod keeps its GPU and disk and is billed at the full hourly rate; a terminated pod's disk is destroyed

egress.terms: not published on the pages read

interface_detail: taken from the documentation index, which lists a REST API reference, a CLI and browser or SSH terminal access; not probed
tooling: REST API with an API key, a CLI, SSH and a browser terminal, Jupyter and VS Code Server one-click apps, vLLM model serving, persistent storage volumes
chaining: Hourly A100 80GB and L40S at USD 0.89 to USD 1.43 and USD 0.92 with SSH and an API, plus a token-billed serverless catalog drawing on the same wallet.

limits.value: a launch needs a funded wallet: the minimum to launch is the first 30 minutes at the pod's hourly rate; Premium GPUs unlock after the first paid top-up and a voucher alone does not launch them

limits_note: A pod launch is gated on a funded wallet (USD 5 to USD 10,000 per top-up by Stripe Checkout); there is no free allowance.
binding_note: A pod launch is gated on a funded wallet (USD 5 to USD 10,000 per top-up by Stripe Checkout); there is no free allowance.

identity_cost.detail: Account creation is by GitHub, Google or email and the sign-up page says 'No credit card needed'; launching a pod needs a wallet top-up of USD 5 to USD 10,000 through Stripe Checkout, which saves the card for auto top-up. No phone or ID document is stated on the pages read.

reliability_note: The aggregator profile states B200s sold out and H200s coming soon; the provider is listed as newer with limited locations. The rate card's H100 SXM and H200 rows read 'Coming soon' on 2026-11-03.
